mapper.sql: e.id, e.student_id, e.status, e.company, e.position, e.salary, e.city, e.school, e.major, e.occur_date, e.remark, e.counselor_id, e.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no, u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM student_record e LEFT JOIN student s ON e.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON e.counselor_id = u.id WHERE e.record_type = 'EMPLOYMENT' AND e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_record (record_type, student_id, status, company, position, salary, city, school, major, occur_date, remark, counselor_id) VALUES ('EMPLOYMENT', #{studentId}, #{employmentStatus}, #{company}, #{position}, #{salary}, #{city}, #{school}, #{major}, #{trackDate}, #{remark}, #{counselorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'EMPLOYMENT' AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'EMPLOYMENT' AND status = #{status}
